verdict.rationale: Docs show that steps are retried independently and automatically, with a default of 4 retries beyond the initial attempt, and that Inngest handles retries and durability so developers don't build their own retry scaffolding. The evidence does not document the configurable parts of the story: backoff strategy, per-step timeouts, or failure policies (the only timeout shown is on waitForEvent). Missing for 10: configurable backoff evidence, step/function timeout configuration, failure-handler/policy documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of retry behavior.
